failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, prompt, knowledge, geometry or cap change. A failure in the smoke stops the chain and pass A does not open; a failure in pass A stops the chain and pass B does not open. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id, which needs BOTH a new generation attempt id AND a new live_phase_fit run and attempt id (a journaled fit cannot be retried under a spent fit identity); a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. RESUME-RECOVERY CLAUSE (owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18): an INFRASTRUCTURE abort with code and request bytes unchanged takes the resume-recovery form of harness item E10 -- the same run id, a fresh attempt id, a resume_from declaration naming the predecessor attempt and its trace SHA-256, every COMPLETE row kept without selection under invariant I7r, every partial or unstarted row re-flown in full, no change to the roster, comparator, decision rule or caps, and the run-cumulative budget re-checked; otherwise the one recovery is a full re-fly under fresh identities. A partial manifest is never scored and never read. If pass A and pass B do not seal on ONE resident session, the pair is not request-identical and the null is not read from it.

generation_budget.definition: The direct-only phase program (configs/policy/phase-direct-only-v1.json: one phase, max_contacts 1, always-run-full-program) makes exactly ONE contact per row, so 400 x 1 = 400 is the program's exact maximum and its expectation at once; the sealed direct baseline realised 4,000 contacts on 4,000 rows. The live phase fit makes 1 + (2 + 1) x 400 = 1201 tokenizer endpoint calls under its own run id SAEA-A2T-STAGE3-AA-PAIRED-400-B-FIT-V1 -- the count core.preparation_fit.complete_phase_endpoint_count requires to the unit; the fit gate refuses any other cap. At the sealed direct baseline's own realised rate (4,000 contacts in 1,518.6 s of generation wall at np3) the generation wall is about 152 s; the GPU-hour ceiling of 0.5 covers fit, packet validation and client initialisation many times over and is a BOUND, never a target. Budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.

purpose: Cell A2T-AA pass B: Audio2Tool's own same-request null, the number every later Audio2Tool interval is read against (owner decision 68; instrument rule 6: the roster's own null is sealed BEFORE any contrast on it; decision 139 puts it on the GPU queue). Two request-identical passes of the sealed direct baseline fly on the paired 400 in ONE chain on ONE resident session -- pass A, then pass B -- and each pass attaches to the session and never spawns or stops it. The read (docs/readiness/2026-09-27-a2t-stage3-aa-paired-400-v1/analysis-recipe-v1.json) is DESCRIPTIVE: request identity per row is proven first (request_sha256 equal on 400 of 400); then per-row byte identity of the delivered tool call between the passes (the count identical of 400); then the pair's difference on the official Audio2Tool tool accuracy (a2t-toolcall-official, the paper-facing scorer, with the repository scorer a2t-toolcall beside it) with a tier-stratified paired bootstrap CI95 whose half-width becomes h_A2T, reported in the natural-mixture and the equal-tier weighting (decision 71) and per tier; beside it, each pass against the sealed direct union-4000 rows of the same 400 ids (SAEA-A2T-NATIVE-ROLE-DIRECT-UNION4000-V1, a cross-campaign A/A reported and never a gate), and contacts per minute (decision 140). It claims no benefit, admits nothing and compares no mechanism. Development numbers only (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim. Nothing here authorises a flight, a readiness flip or an admission entry.
